name: Nanaza
attested_in: Ur III text from Urusagrig, Nisaba 15 371: 1-7 (oil ration)
note: Laursen & Steinkeller 2017: 'the only evidence available' on the Meluhhan language

name: (..)-ibra
attested_in: list of rebel kings against Naram-Sin, Schoyen MS 2814 (literary)

name: Lu-sunzida
people: 'man of Meluhha' (Sumerian name, possibly a calque)
note: Sumerian name; not Meluhhan in form

name: Ri'mum
people: Dilmun ruler ('servant of Inzak of Agarum')
attested_in: Durand stone, Bahrain (lost); restored on Qal'at al-Bahrain vessel A23435
note: Amorite-type name; later than the Gulf Type seals
source: UNESCO Memory of the World nomination 219 (Cuneiform Inscriptions of Dilmun Kings on Stone Vessels)

name: Yagli-El
attested_in: inscribed stone vessels, Qal'at al-Bahrain (A23400, A23435, A23408, A21108)
note: Amorite name; later than the Gulf Type seals

name: Sumu-lel
attested_in: Failaka stamp seal, Kuwait Museum no. 1050

name: Su-ilisu
attested_in: cylinder seal of the Akkadian period (Louvre)
note: Akkadian name; shows Meluhhan language needed interpreters

name: Ur-Ninildum son of Ur-gi
people: owner of a round seal with an Indus bull (Cabinet des Medailles, Paris, unpublished)
syllables: Sumerian names; formula NAME dumu ('son of') NAME
